question: Which ointment ingredients destroy the spider-related affliction?
premises: Red sandalwood and costus are specified.
Costus is mentioned again as part of the remedy.
The preparation is an ointment that destroys the spider affliction.
inference: An ointment of red sandalwood and costus destroys the spider-related affliction.
uncertainties: The repetition of kuṣṭhaṃ may be emphatic or textual; taken as given.
plain_english: An ointment of red sandalwood and costus destroys the spider affliction.
